title: Merge overlapping intervals
statement:
Test USDC, no monetary value.

Read one line of intervals written `a-b` (whole numbers from 0 up, a not above b), separated by spaces, in any order. Merge the ones that overlap or touch at an end point (`1-3` and `3-5` give `1-5`; `1-3` and `4-5` stay apart). Print the result in rising order, separated by spaces.
